patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Instantly's shape. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Instantly leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom..
- Company-size focus: Bombora (mid-market, enterprise) vs Instantly (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Instantly-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core.

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases.

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Instantly's motion (Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
